title: I vibecoded a tiny browser “Fidget Cube” or "Fidget Toy" game and I would love feedback from other AI/game devs
author: ZealousidealProof392
selftext:
[https://teroli21-pa.github.io/Fidget-Toy/](https://teroli21-pa.github.io/Fidget-Toy/)

honestly, when i first made it on claude ai sonnet 4.6 with max effort, it's still very buggy and laggy, missing a lot features, claude usage also gets full in single use, so i had to switch to chatgpt but get full yet again, wait another day, try it again but failed because claude ai single use more than it should so the message was failed to be generated. it requires many days and finally completed (in my opinion). sometimes i had to fix it or add it manually because chatgpt doesn't understand me or claude ai website so laggy it crashed my browser.

note: i don't have pc, i am using cheap android device, i do what i can, search what i can find, i basically trying everything i can to make this game fully running stable

note: i am not Native English speaker, i don't use translator
